content:
- Completed the HA boundary cleanup by collapsing internal ReconcilePlan into the existing PlannedActions shape, removing the AuthorityProjectionState rename, and deleting the processed found_smell note.
- Ran cargo fmt --all, make lint, and make test successfully. make test required one retry after `cargo clean --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu -p pgtuskmaster_rust` because the known nextest incremental-linking bug reproduced once; the successful run finished with 232 passed, 16 skipped, and the existing 5 leaky tests.
- Committed as 0959738 (Collapse HA planned action mirrors), pushed to origin/master, and ran bash .ralph/task_switch.sh. The switch refreshed current task summaries, sent the status email, and printed the same harmless missing .ralph/current_task.txt removal message.

- Read prior Ralph progress (no prior output returned) and loaded the improve-code-boundaries skill.
- Checked git status: existing unrelated changes in .ralph files, src/pginfo/startup.rs, and tests/ha/support/timeouts/mod.rs; must avoid reverting user work.
- Next: inspect found_smells/ and pick one required boundary issue, then trace the relevant code before editing.

- Found required queued smell files under .agents/skills/improve-code-boundaries/found_smells.
- Chose the smell-1 candidate ranking issue in src/ha/decide.rs because it is localized and avoids the user-modified files.
- Read the smell guidance and traced the helper chain: classify_candidate -> candidate_rank -> compare_candidate_rank; next step is to collapse ranking directly onto ElectionEligibility and keep tests green.

- Patched src/ha/decide.rs to remove the CandidateRank/classify helper layer and compare ElectionEligibility directly.
- Reused the direct eligibility comparator for both switchover and failover ordering, and added a test for bootstrap peer selection against an ineligible self candidate.
- Next: run lint/tests, then delete the processed smell file if everything passes.

- Started make lint and make test per task instructions.
- Waiting on repo-wide validation; will treat any lint/test failure as a real blocker and fix or report it instead of bypassing.
- Next: inspect outputs, then remove the processed found_smells file and commit/push if green.

- make lint and make test failed only on this refactor: stale WalPosition import and a clippy needless-borrow in the new comparator.
- Patched both issues in src/ha/decide.rs.
- Next: rerun lint/test; if green, delete the processed found-smell file and proceed to commit/push/task switch.

- Rerun in progress: make test is compiling forward, make lint is temporarily blocked on the shared cargo target lock.
- No new functional failures yet.
- Next: wait for both validations to complete, then clean up the processed smell file and prepare the commit.

- make test failed during linking with missing rcgu object files while lint and test were building concurrently against the same cargo target dir.
- This looks like a build-race/environment issue rather than a Rust compile/test regression from the refactor.
- Next: let make lint finish, then rerun make test sequentially on its own for a reliable result.

- make lint completed successfully.
- Earlier make test failure was a linker race from running lint and test in parallel against the same cargo target dir.
- Next: rerun make test sequentially, then delete the processed smell file and commit/push if it passes.

- Sequential make test rerun is in progress after the earlier cargo target race.
- No new output yet beyond the rebuild starting.
- Next: wait for the final test result, then clean up found_smells and move to git steps.

- make test finished: the HA decide tests, including the new bootstrap/ineligible case, passed.
- Repo-wide test suite still fails in 8 existing tests under tests/cli_binary.rs with No such file or directory when spawning the CLI binaries; lint remains green.
- Next: record this as a bug per repo policy, then decide whether any safe cleanup/commit step remains possible with the suite red.

- Recorded the unrelated cli_binary spawn failure as a Ralph bug task.
- Cleaned up the processed improve-code-boundaries smell note.
- Next: stage only this task's files plus Ralph bookkeeping, commit, push, and then run task_switch while leaving unrelated user edits alone.

- Staged only the HA decide refactor, processed smell cleanup, bug task, and Ralph bookkeeping; unrelated user edits in src/pginfo/startup.rs and tests/ha/support/timeouts/mod.rs remain unstaged.
- Started git commit with message: Collapse HA candidate ranking helpers. A post-commit hook is publishing docs.
- Next: wait for commit completion, inspect any hook-produced changes, then push and run .ralph/task_switch.sh.

- Commit completed as e90d741 (Collapse HA candidate ranking helpers) and pushed to origin/master.
- Remaining unstaged changes are only the expected post-commit Ralph/progress churn plus the user's unrelated src/pginfo/startup.rs and tests/ha/support/timeouts/mod.rs edits.
- Next: run .ralph/task_switch.sh and capture its result for the handoff summary.
